description: Defines the MidiManagerWin class, a Windows-specific implementation of MIDI management, including device handling, data transmission, and system monitoring.

classes.name: MidiManagerWin
classes.description: A Windows-specific MIDI manager implementing device management, data transmission, and system monitoring, with nested classes for port management.

methods.name: OverflowInstanceIdForTesting
methods.description: Static method to overflow the instance ID, used for testing.

methods.name: StartInitialization
methods.description: Overrides MidiManager method to start initialization.

methods.name: DispatchSendMidiData
methods.description: Overrides MidiManager method to send MIDI data to a client.

methods.name: OnDevicesChanged
methods.description: Overrides SystemMonitor::DevicesChangedObserver method to handle device changes.

methods.name: ReceiveMidiData
methods.description: Handles incoming MIDI data from a specific port.

methods.name: PostTask
methods.description: Posts a task to the task runner.

methods.name: PostDelayedTask
methods.description: Posts a delayed task to the task runner.

methods.name: PostReplyTask
methods.description: Posts a reply task to the I/O thread.

methods.name: InitializeOnTaskRunner
methods.description: Initializes the instance asynchronously on the task runner.

methods.name: UpdateDeviceListOnTaskRunner
methods.description: Updates the device list on the task runner; returns true if changed.

methods.name: ReflectActiveDeviceList
methods.description: Reflects active port list to device list for a given port type.

methods.name: SendOnTaskRunner
methods.description: Sends MIDI data on the task runner.
